post.description:
Register a new user with personal and company information, plus optional document uploads.

**Request Format:** multipart/form-data

**Required Fields (in 'data' JSON):**
- companyId: Company ID (number)
- name: User's first name (string)
- email: User's email address (string, must be unique)
- password: User's password (string, will be hashed)
- identification: User's ID number (string)

**Optional Fields (in 'data' JSON):**
- lastName, phone, userType, priceType, profileType, etc.
- For profileType="majority": socialReason, identificationCorporate, identificationType, emailCorporate, legalRepresentative, phoneCorporate, cellPhoneCorporate
- Address fields: country, department, city, neighborhood, address, additionalInfo

**Optional File Uploads:**
- photo: Single profile photo (jpg, png, etc.)
- identityCardFiles[]: Multiple identity card images (you can send multiple files with the same field name)
- chamberCommerceFiles[]: Multiple chamber of commerce documents (PDF, images)
- rutFiles[]: Multiple RUT (tax registration) documents (PDF, images)

**Example 'data' field value:**
```json
{
"companyId": 1,
"name": "John",
"lastName": "Doe",
"email": "john@example.com",
"password": "securepass123",
"identification": "12345678",
"phone": "3001234567",
"userType": "customer",
"profileType": "majority",
"socialReason": "Company Inc",
"identificationCorporate": "900123456",
"identificationType": "NIT"
}
```

**Files are uploaded to Cloudflare R2 and URLs are stored in the database.**
post.summary: Register a new user with optional file uploads

parameters.description: User registration data as JSON string (see description for format)
parameters.name: data

parameters.description: Identity card files (you can send this parameter multiple times for multiple files)
parameters.name: identityCardFiles

Update user information with optional file uploads. Supports both JSON and multipart/form-data requests.

**JSON Mode (Content-Type: application/json):**
Send user fields to update. Only provided fields will be updated.

**Multipart Mode (Content-Type: multipart/form-data):**
Use when updating files. Send 'data' field with JSON string + file fields.

**Updatable Fields:**
- Basic: name, lastName, identification, phone, email, password
- Status: isActive, isCredit, isClient, isProvider, isUser
- Types: userType, profileType, priceType
- Company (if profileType="majority"): socialReason, identificationCorporate, identificationType, emailCorporate, legalRepresentative, phoneCorporate, cellPhoneCorporate
- Other: comissionRate, commercialName, birthday

**File Uploads (multipart only):**
- photo: Profile photo (replaces existing)
- identityCardFiles: Identity documents (replaces ALL existing identity files)
- chamberCommerceFiles: Commerce documents (replaces ALL existing commerce files)
- rutFiles: RUT documents (replaces ALL existing RUT files)

**Important:** Files are REPLACED by type, not merged. Omit file fields to keep existing files.

**Example JSON request:**
```json
{
"userId": 315,
"name": "Juan Pérez",
"phone": "3001234567"
}
```

**Example multipart 'data' field:**
```json
{
"userId": 315,
"name": "María González",
"profileType": "majority",
"socialReason": "González Corp SAS"
}
```
